open_findings.consequence: A clean setup following the documented Node range can use a runtime outside the verification toolchain support.
open_findings.reproduction: Compare the advertised Node >=22.12 with the locked and installed jsdom 30.1.3 engines range ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0. Node 22.12 and 24.0 fall outside the latter.
open_findings.resolution_evidence: Round 2 independent review reproduced the lockfile and manifest engine agreement, documented matching range, and passing compatibility regressions on the reviewed snapshot. See review.md, Initial round 2.

open_findings.consequence: Low contrast makes the 11 px date and percentage labels and chart captions harder to read for people with reduced contrast sensitivity.
open_findings.reproduction: Compute foreground contrast on the white chart card: #748093 is 4.00:1 and #8893a2 is 3.11:1, both below the ordinary-text legibility benchmark of 4.5:1.
open_findings.resolution_evidence: Round 2 independent review calculated 6.306:1 contrast for axis labels and captions and reproduced passing contrast regressions on the reviewed snapshot. See review.md, Initial round 2.

open_findings.consequence: The SPA renders a blank page, so its chart and accessible example content are unavailable.
open_findings.reproduction: Start the Vite server and open or reload / in Chrome. The body is blank and the console reports that ExampleChart attempted to render an invalid element type: object.
open_findings.evidence: verification.md, Independent QA; evidence/qa-dispatch.json and evidence/qa-after.json

dependency_decision.current_license_observation: The initial dependency installation installed apexcharts@8.7.0 and react-apexcharts@2.2.0. Their bundled licenses describe the dual-license model, and the official vendor license page states that installation signifies agreement to applicable terms. Eligibility was not checked. The legal effect of the installation is undetermined.
dependency_decision.status: The app now pins the publisher's MIT-licensed apexcharts@4.7.0 and react-apexcharts@1.7.0. Independent browser QA of the initial implementation failed on a runtime import issue.
